Subject: DataCo trial: success criteria, owners, and kickoff scheduling

Hi Alex / Samantha —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick summary and proposed next steps so we can lock the 3-week trial scope and owners.

Key goals we heard from your team (proposed success criteria):
- Ingestion: Redwood should process a 10k-record ingest with schema validation and <2 hour end-to-end availability for search & generation.
- Latency: Average prompt-to-token latency <= 350ms at 1 RPS sustained during evaluation window.
- Quality: Precision@5 for retrieval-augmented responses >= 82% on your QA set (we'll work together on the eval set).
- Security: No customer PII leaves your VPC; audit logs retained for 90 days.

Proposed scope & timeline (draft):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + S3 access + sample dataset ingest (owner: DataCo engineering)
- Week 1: Baseline runs + tuning (owners: Redwood eng / DataCo eng)
- Week 2: Focused evals against your QA prompts + acceptance gating (owners: product/ops)
- Week 3: Readout + handoff + decision (contract/sizing)

Owners we suggest:
- Redwood trial lead: Mina Haddad (me)
- Redwood technical lead: Ben Carter (cc'd)
- DataCo technical lead: Alex Jordan (please confirm)

Open items / asks for kickoff:
1) Confirm technical owner for DataCo and a Slack channel for real-time troubleshooting.
2) Provide S3 read-only credentials & example dataset by EOD Wed (07/07).
3) Share your QA prompts/Eval rubric in the linked Drive folder (I'll create it).
4) Let us know if SOC2 scope or additional compliance docs are required prior to kickoff.

Attachments: dataco-trial-plan.xlsx (draft schedule + acceptance criteria)

If this matches your understanding I'll schedule a 45-minute kickoff for Thu (07/08) 16:00 ET — please reply with availability.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
